    run.go:283: 0: expected error creating {"metadata":{"name":"test","creationTimestamp":null},"spec":{"initContainers":[{"name":"initcontainer1","image":"k8s.gcr.io/pause","resources":{},"securityContext":{"allowPrivilegeEscalation":false}}],"containers":[{"name":"container1","image":"k8s.gcr.io/pause","resources":{},"securityContext":{"allowPrivilegeEscalation":false,"procMount":"Unmasked"}}],"serviceAccountName":"default","securityContext":{"runAsNonRoot":true}},"status":{}}, got none

Thank you @liggitt! I've made the changes :)

issue_context.title: [PodSecurity] baseline - procMount type
issue_context.body:
Implement the "procMount" check from https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/security/pod-security-standards/#baseline

- [ ] implement check_procMount.go for the baseline policy
  - fail if any containers set `securityContext.procMount` to any value other than `Default`, include the relevant container names and invalid values in the forbidden details
  - see staging/src/k8s.io/pod-security-admission/policy/check_addCapabilities.go as an example
- [ ] implement fixtures_procMount.go
  - see staging/src/k8s.io/pod-security-admission/test/fixtures_addCapabilities.go as an example
  - generatePass should return pods with containers that don't set procMount, and which do set procMount to `Default`
  - generateFail should generate test cases
    - container that sets procMount to `Unmasked`
    - initContainer that sets procMount to `Unmasked`
  - run `UPDATE_POD_SECURITY_FIXTURE_DATA=true go test k8s.io/pod-security-admission/test` to update test fixtures
  - run `go test ./test/integration/auth -v -run PodSecurity` to ensure integration tests pass

review_comments: note to self: the procMount field was added in 1.12+, but since this is forbidding an escalating value in a new field, it's ok for this to be included in the 1.0+ policy levels (it would still pass a pod that omitted the value in a server prior to 1.12)

ah, the integration tests are unhappy because this is still an alpha field, so it is not persisted unless the ProcMountType feature gate is enabled... the check implementation looks correct (forbid an escalating value in the field), but the failure cases are tricky to write if the feature that allows data to be persisted in that field is disabled... let me think about how to test that

opened https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/103365 to let the failure cases declare features they depend on

use for this would look like the last commit of https://github.com/liggitt/kubernetes/commits/proc-mount-baseline

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/103365 is merged, can rebase on master and set `failRequiresFeatures` like https://github.com/liggitt/kubernetes/commit/0caca308702055eb48eda7c58bfbaf32c0ccc72e and this should be good
